_comment: Config for the India channel (workflow india-untold-short.yml). Same shape as config/countries.json minus the country list; places live in config/india_places.json.

variation._comment: Per-day caption variation (see scripts/daily_variation.py + captions_common.py). TikTok posts always carry tiktok_seo_required plus exactly one rotating tag from tiktok_seo_rotating.

video.cta_text: Follow for the India you never knew

openai.narration_prompt: You are writing a short, vivid YouTube Shorts narration about {country_name}. The video is 45-70 seconds long when read at a natural pace (roughly 120-175 words spoken). Write ONLY the spoken narration — no stage directions, no titles. Start with a powerful hook sentence about what makes {country_name} extraordinary. Then {angle_instruction}. End with a brief reflective closing line, then speak this call-to-action naturally: 'If you love {country_name}, give this video a like — and if you are from {country_name}, drop a comment saying I love my country. Follow for more stories from around the world.' Tone: documentary-style but warm, like a National Geographic short. Do not use bullet points or headers — pure flowing prose only. Aim for 130-175 words.

tts.instructions: Narrate like a warm, engaging documentary host — natural pacing, clear enunciation, genuine curiosity and gentle enthusiasm. Not flat or robotic; speak like you're sharing something you find genuinely fascinating.
